body.summary: K0 closed in DONE-20260927-knowledge-k0-contracts; K1 closed in DONE-20260926-knowledge-k1-identity. K2–K6 implementations and K7a tooling are on main. The token-mode K7a pilot passed on an isolated copy at 6423734 (k7a-token-pilot-20260927.md); cutover, K2–K6 acceptance reconciliation and K8/K9 remain in the parent. SQLite remains current; PostgreSQL is deferred. Read the dated status at the top of implementation-plan.md before its historical sequence. Storage safety assessment and S0–S6 completion plan added on 2026-09-28; RWK-20260928-sqlite-data-safety tracks technical prerequisites before real-project cutover. Storage safety plan refreshed on 2026-10-01 against 6a9df6e: schema 27, pre-migration backup and ownership gaps rechecked; proposed recovery targets, backup retention/off-host protection, bounded PR sequence, restore recovery and production upgrade procedure added. Operational parameters remain proposed; no implementation or production change was performed. Owner clarified that backups are optional and configured only through CLI parameters, with GUI limited to browsing and optional operator-authorized on-demand creation/restore. The current plan supersedes mandatory backup assumptions: automatic backups default off, migration gates apply only when enabled, and SaaS tenant administrators cannot manage global backups. A further owner proposal adds independent application user-space schedules managed through GUI/API within CLI policy. Service schedule/retention remain CLI-only; user timing/retention are separate and execution is shared and bounded. SaaS user schedules cover authorized logical exports, never whole-installation SQLite backups. S4u records this additional scope. The plan now defines one feature branch/worktree and PR per slice, sequential main-based delivery and a first-run handoff in storage-safety-worker-01.md. Each worker run ends at a reviewable PR; merge and production rollout are separate. S1a + S2a implemented on feat/sqlite-pre-migration-backup at 7f9f82ce2a9bf24b7d174cbdacd939c1bb952ada and submitted in PR #68 on 2026-10-01. Managed check/build/integration/UI verification passed on that clean revision. The dated slice report records run IDs, fixture origins and limits. The PR remains open; no merge, production rollout or later slice was performed. Review follow-up on 2026-10-01 classified the single WAL startup claim as false positive after isolated SIGKILL tests with present/missing shared-memory index. Four crash cases were added in f1f02a6b42d3eb3539c53055eab96dd63e417df3; managed check passed with 552 Vitest and 7 script tests. The original thread has an evidence reply and is resolved; the report includes the follow-up and separates earlier build/integration/UI results. PR #68 was merged at afe9f20. S1b + S2b was delivered from that main baseline on feat/sqlite-durable-migrations at fced54c4f94111fb0f815ba4a100de2d864372e2 in open PR #69 (2026-10-01). WAL/FULL verification, private owned data paths, atomic initialization/migrations, honest migration-28 provenance and startup integrity/FK/application checks are implemented. Final managed check (585 Vitest + 7 scripts), build, integration (23) and separate ext4 write-cost preset passed; Chromium (134) passed on 9b0fcc3 before fixture-only permission changes. Isolated package smoke at umask 022 passed through the host heavy runner. Dated report and raw evidence record revision attribution, failures corrected and limitations. Overall task remains open; no power-loss test, old installed-artifact upgrade, production change, merge or next slice was performed. Addressed PR #69 review on 2026-10-01: one valid restore-sidecar regression fixed in caea79a, final feature SHA ee55994f0156cc4bcd0fb320632f0a972bc20758. Restore now quarantines .initializing and -journal with the old database and restores them on publication failure. Managed check (588 Vitest + 7 scripts), build and built CLI integration (24) passed on the clean final revision with observed_match. An initial fixture import failure is recorded and corrected. Evidence reply posted; full thread re-fetch confirms 1 fix, 0 backlog, 0 false positives, 0 unresolved. Report and raw evidence updated. PR remains draft; overall task stays open. No merge, deployment, production change or later slice. PR #69 is merged at f2aeef2c7f29427ecff36c53450fbbb69f41c01a. Implemented only S3a from that fetched main in separate worktree worktree-switcher-s3a and branch feat/sqlite-durable-attachments. Open PR https://github.com/pioootrek/worktree-switcher/pull/70, feature SHA ffdff68a67e76baa22238789f7712fd538230c48. Upload, Hub import, project import and backup attachment copies share private staging, size/hash verification, file fsync, exclusive no-overwrite publication and directory fsync before SQL commit. Immutable published objects survive rollback and metadata deletion, preserving shared hashes and every snapshot source through backup copying; no new live database connection, lock map or automatic GC. Public formats/schema 28 and optional default-off backups remain. Sequential managed check (632 Vitest + 7 scripts), build, built CLI integration (25) and Chromium (134) all passed on the clean feature SHA with observed_match. Guarded package smoke passed 14 steps with graceful cleanup. Tests include nine ext4 SIGKILL boundaries across three paths, SQL rollback/retry with shared hashes, simultaneous publishers, snapshot interleavings, injected EIO/ENOSPC/EACCES and actual directory permission denial. Earlier fixture/typecheck failures and dirty-source attribution are recorded in the dated S3a report and evidence. SIGKILL is not power-loss evidence; no real disk-full, macOS, hardware, old installed-artifact upgrade, production database or deployment test. Orphans/staging may consume disk; full backup/restore durability stays in S3b and scheduling/GUI in S4. Overall task stays open; no merge or later slice. Addressed PR #70 review in af34b7b31b843281ee08305bff464045e2a3ce61: 2 fix, 0 backlog, 0 false positives. Owned legacy root/shard directories with writable umask modes (0775) are safely narrowed to 0700 using an inode-checked no-follow descriptor, also on backup source lookup. Directory fsync stops at shard/root/existing data or backup-staging parent; publisher never creates outer ancestors, and retry still synchronizes every entry it can create. Real legacy and execute-only fixtures cover upload, both imports, backup and interrupted retry; symlinks/foreign ownership/writable outer ancestors remain refused. Managed check passed (646 Vitest + 7 scripts), build and built CLI integration (25) passed on the clean SHA with observed_match. Both original threads have evidence replies and are resolved; full re-fetch confirms 0 unresolved. Dated report/raw evidence updated. UI/package smoke results remain attributed only to the original ffdff68 SHA. No power-loss or old installed-artifact upgrade proof, production changes, merge or later slice; optional backups remain default-off and the overall task stays open. PR #70 was confirmed merged at c5c49e2a6bcfd0a15db533b8acfa31d042666222 on 2026-10-01. S3b started from that fetched origin/main in separate worktree on feat/sqlite-recoverable-restore. Before coding, the recovery states, durable intent, per-rename synchronization, failure behavior and controlled request handoff were described in storage-safety-s3b-protocol.md. S3b implementation and verification remain in progress. S3b implementation is submitted in PR #71 at 486061f677001b6b3dd6e2f9992c596be986f79d. Final clean-source queue check (718 Vitest + 7 scripts), build, integration (26) and Chromium (134) all passed with observed_match on the exact implementation SHA. External durable restore journal, exclusive pre-open recovery, strict private staging, complete previous-set retention and controlled idempotent request protocol are implemented. The dated S3b report/evidence record limitations; the parent remains open for S4/S5. No merge or production deployment. S3b final implementation is frozen at 34533a7c9f4eba85cee27f91d56f1217916e7719 in open PR #71. Clean-source managed check (722 Vitest including 76 restore cases + 7 scripts), build, built CLI integration (26) and Chromium UI (134) all passed on this exact SHA with observed_match. GitHub CI 36897518466 attempt 1 passed check/build/HTTPS/integration but failed mobile detail-focus.spec.ts:28 after Escape (133 UI PASS, 1 FAIL); E2E/package checks were skipped. Browser code/config/tests are unchanged from the base. Escape did not dismiss an open drawer; a Radix listener/navigation transition race is a hypothesis, not a proven cause. CI uploaded no failure artifacts. Attempt 2 was requested before the owner stop instruction and cancelled during check; no further full reruns or restore changes. Report/evidence and PR description now reflect the final SHA and actual results. Remaining blocker is targeted diagnosis with retained trace before full CI retry. Overall task stays open for S4/S5; no merge, deployment or host service/limit change. S3b closeout: PR #71 merged as 42859c9d34db15b060e2f553c5e75a55af8c1175, final head 99f53b69441a33617abacd6cbca8516e1632c9d9. Mobile Escape race fixed with regression and green final CI 36907715558; the dated S3b report/evidence supersede the previous blocker. Parent stays open for S4/S5; no production deployment. S4a delivered for review in PR #72 (https://github.com/pioootrek/worktree-switcher/pull/72), frozen head 1147b2ff0269eb6d63dd3df81a104b5aee22707c. CLI-only immutable optional service policy, bounded durable backup execution/scheduling/retention, installation-token operator GUI and controlled S3b maintenance/handoff/restart are implemented. Exact clean-source managed check (769 Vitest + 7 scripts), build, integration (28), UI (142) and focused backup UI (7) passed with observed_match. Final CI 36917252428 passed, including installed-package smoke on Node 22.23.2 and 24.21.0 and disposable-runner systemd lifecycle. Report and sanitized evidence: storage-safety-s4a-report-20261001.md / storage-safety-s4a-evidence-20261001.json. Parent stays open; S4a awaits review/merge, S4u/S4b/S5 are untouched. No production/host-service change. Power loss, physical disk exhaustion, old-installed-artifact upgrade and actual browser 200% zoom remain unverified; no delivery blocker. S4a PR #72 review follow-up: both inline findings classified fix, published and resolved; no backlog/false-positive/unresolved concerns. Active CLI resolves relative backup destinations in the operator cwd; unknown restore status returns safe backup_invalid (HTTP 404) after current authorization. Final head de89e998149112ffbe44c10f4a6a2a420c049ebb. New compiled-controller and HTTP regressions passed. Initial follow-up check/CI 36923843336 failed only because the new fixture used an invalid backup ID; logs were retained, the ID corrected without weakening 404 assertions, and focused backup tests passed (53) before full verification. Final clean-source managed check (770 Vitest + 7 scripts), build, integration (29) and UI (142) passed with observed_match; CI 36924532217 including package smoke and disposable-runner lifecycle is green. Dated S4a report/evidence updated; previous delivery results preserved. Parent remains open; no merge/deployment/next slice. On 2026-10-02, five unpublished Opus findings from n8n execution 9579 were recovered and verified: the relative CLI destination was already fixed after Kimi, and four fixes added independent service-history bounds, cancellation of admitted starts and HTTP listener drain, bounded asynchronous snapshot verification with reauthorization and durable disconnected-client handoff, and distinct unverified pre-migration catalog labels in PL/EN. Final clean feature head dcbf1a7e7dc47001710fe26dc5daf113ff708ae1 passed 64 focused tests, lint/types with 782 Vitest plus 7 scripts, build, 30 integrations and 144 UI tests through managed MCP. CI 36932383355 is green, including 14-step installed-artifact smoke on Node 22.23.2/24.21.0 and disposable-runner lifecycle. Artifact checksums/provenance and bundled verifier were audited; failed and cancelled runs remain recorded separately. Manual-key history keeps its 1024 bound and safe exhaustion procedure remains an operational follow-up in the open parent. S4a stays in PR #72 for review; no merge, rollout or next slice. S4u delivered for review in PR #73 (https://github.com/pioootrek/worktree-switcher/pull/73), final feature SHA 31e9ccd9e22d4dcf0e1e85656b4d841b8fee13f3. Independent default-off CLI user policy, scoped-principal GUI/API schedules, narrow project discussion projection, shared single S4a executor with service priority, external durable version/deadline/idempotency records, isolated retention and online/offline restore credential revalidation are implemented. No SQLite schema change or second live connection. Clean managed build/integration (32)/UI (164) passed on final SHA with observed_match. Earlier local check (827 + 7 scripts) and focused S4u (46 including three SIGKILL boundaries) retain their original SHA attribution. Final CI 37050621798 is green: lint/types, 828 Vitest + 7 scripts, build/HTTPS, integration/UI/E2E (3), 14-step installed package smoke on Node 22.23.2 and 24.21.0, disposable systemd lifecycle. Package SHA256 c8cc7e154df46acbd39b62b627c7b947b83898c058a1ceea761f4d2987d1f615 from clean synthetic merge f937bd9ef82d9b2531a13cf9feacb29808b7d7a4; checksums/provenance/bundled S4u audited. Dated report, sanitized evidence and selected screenshots record corrected failures, changed-source exclusion and limits. Only knowledge-discussions is available; no SaaS human-account adapter, hard filesystem-call timeout, power-loss proof, old-artifact upgrade or external-ledger new-host recovery proof. Parent remains open; no merge/deployment, host limits/service change, transfer, client restore, attachment GC or S4b/S5 work. PR #73 review follow-up on 2026-10-03: 1 fix, 2 backlog, 0 false positives, 0 unresolved after a full thread re-fetch. Service refresh without user-policy flags inherits and revalidates the installed generated systemd/launchd user arguments; unsupported definitions fail before mutation and explicit flags replace the whole user policy. Application fix 8cd684de4646806c8cc6daa6fbe16eeb5b660e95, final feature SHA fa011f6972948d479ebf698ee8c629469c527222 after correcting a test ProcessEnv type. Focused MCP passed 54 tests on 8cd684d; initial check failed NODE_ENV fixture typing and remains evidence. Final clean-source MCP check passed lint/types with 836 Vitest + 7 scripts, build and 32 integrations with observed_match. CI 37101748053 passed all four jobs, including HTTPS/UI (164)/E2E (3), 14-step installed package smoke on Node 22/24 and disposable systemd lifecycle. Artifact from clean synthetic merge fff33842189500ca19d575fb85c1c911a8cddbb8, SHA256 10bf8d5cf91c91bdaca96f6c9aa4870d51071b6fbd0e85203893f73827005976; checksums/provenance and bundled refresh reader audited. Two valid operational issues remain in the dated parent notes: global immutable-key exhaustion/fairness and recovery/reclaim of interrupted export quota. Backlog outcomes were committed on main in af6bbc9 before replies; no pruning/GC implemented. All three review threads have evidence replies and are resolved. Report/evidence/plan updated on main; original results retain their SHA. No merge, new review dispatch, production/host service changes or later slice. S4u closeout on 2026-10-03: PR #73 merged as 1f9c90f after integrating both agent branches, fixing uncharged staging and explicit recovery of retained-success capacity. Final 6f3db2f passed all managed checks and CI 37117584381; n8n Claude findings were fixed and Codex final review found no new issues. Kimi timed out and is recorded incomplete. See storage-safety-s4u-closeout-20261003.md and evidence. Parent remains open for S4b/S5; production unchanged. S4b PR #74 has completed local acceptance on 04f4d01: optional CLI-only restic HTTPS transfer, source-deleted recovery and installed package smoke. n8n all reviewed; CI/merge pending. See dated S4b report/evidence; operational S5 remains open. S4b PR #74 merged at 963b011aa2bc5b5c04b90a33dcb1005246173992 after CI37124183610 passed all four jobs; report/evidence now include artifact provenance and exact review outcomes. Remaining S5 scope is explicit. S5a PR #75 merged at 4bebff9 after exact-head managed verification, all four CI jobs and completed n8n review (1 fix, 0 unresolved). Optional finite CLI monitor delivered; see dated report/evidence. S5b follows the committed repository-rebind contract; S5c remains. Host, keys and rollout are separate per owner. S5b PR #76 merged as 3e99b7b95055ae125749d54bfbebe9975d015cc6 from e9b7e6c. Offline repository rebind, preserved archived receipts/pins, explicit single reupload and bounded durable history reconciliation delivered. Focused58/check965+7/build and final HTTPS/installed acceptance passed with revision attribution; CI37137172368 all four jobs green. One n8n round:3 fixes,0 unresolved. Dated report/evidence preserve earlier failures and exact artifacts. S5c starts under its accepted installed-artifact contract; item remains open. Target host, keys and rollout separate; no production/service changes.
